title: Juicy Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Tender beef skewers with a mustardy flavor, featuring oranges and a cheese-pull, perfect for a date-night dinner
instructions: Preheat the pressure cooker to high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Close the pressure cooker lid and set the valve to sealing
Cook the beef skewers for 10 minutes, then quick-release the pressure
Brush the beef skewers with orange marmalade during the last 2 minutes of cooking
Remove the skewers from the pressure cooker and top with dairy-free cheese shreds
Serve immediately, garnished with orange slices
